newsitem.title: CANADA: UGG board adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: UGG board adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: United Grain Growers Ltd said on Friday its board of directors adopted a shareholder rights plan designed to encourage the fair treatment of shareholders if there were to be an unsolicited takeover bid for UGG.

UGG said the rights plan is effective immediately and will provide the board and the shareholders more time to fully consider a bid if one is made and more time for the board to pursue, if appropriate, other options.
The plan is also designed to protect shareholders from unfair, abusive or coercive takeover strategies, including "creeping" takeover bids.
